target.statement: Achieved load (fill rate) of a (2,2) windowed Cuckoo filter at FPR 2^-14 with 10^9 slots and max random walk length 10,000, converging to the theoretical threshold ~0.965

compute.basis: Pure CPU numba/Python filter benchmark on synthetic keys; a 10^9-slot filter (~2 GB) with 10k-step walks takes tens of seconds to a few minutes per run, plus install and JIT warmup; smaller n (10^7-10^8) reproduces the load trend in minutes.

blockers: 10^9-slot runs need ~2-4 GB RAM and several minutes each; may need to scale down n to fit time budget
numba JIT compilation adds startup overhead
title: Smaller and More Flexible Cuckoo Filters
